email.body:
Dear Operations,

MV VALDA CREST - Rotterdam, Rijnmond Energy Coal Terminal

The line-up is unchanged. The berth will be ready on VALDA CREST's arrival, and the terminal expects to berth her on arrival as planned.

Please keep us informed of the vessel's ETA.

Best regards,
Operations desk
Maasport Agencies, Rotterdam
